div.div:
مُغْيِن , in the original form, [for مُغِين, act. part. n. of أَغَانَ,] is used by Ru-beh in the following verse: “أَمْسَى بِلَالٌ كَالرَّبِيعِ المُدْجِنِ
أَمْطَرَ فِى أَكْنَافِ غَيْنٍ مُغْيِنِ
” [There was, or came, in the evening, a moisture like the continual rain of winter that has rained in the tracts of overspreading clouds]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
